concepts.definition: an electronic device that accepts data, processes it according to instructions, stores information, and produces output
hardware used to enter data or commands into a computer system
hardware that presents processed information from a computer to a user or another system
a named collection of related digital data stored on a device
a global system of interconnected computer networks that communicate using standard protocols
a secret string used with an account or system to help verify a user's identity
software used to retrieve, display, and interact with content on the World Wide Web
software that organizes data in cells arranged in rows and columns and supports calculation
a clear sequence of steps designed to complete a task or solve a problem
practices that reduce digital risks and protect people, devices, accounts, and information online
